say:2:1122403001:1.text: We trusted you, Silverbeak! And what do we get for it?!
say:2:1122403001:1.source_cn: 银喙，我们以前那么信任你，结果你是怎么对我们的？！

say:3:1122403002:1.text: Always giving us the toughest jobs! In the end, you end up with our hard-earned cash! How come you're the only one who gets to live the easy life?!
say:3:1122403002:1.source_cn: 每次都把最危险最累的事甩给兄弟，最后还卷走我们的辛苦钱...

say:4:1122403003:1.text: That's bullcrap, and you know it! I've never shortchanged you!
say:4:1122403003:1.source_cn: 少胡说八道！我没卷走你们的钱！

say:5:1122403004:1.text: You guys didn't believe me in the beginning! And now you're acting like a bunch of mudscrapers!
say:5:1122403004:1.source_cn: 你们当初就不相信我，直到现在，还是这副德行！

say:6:1122403005:1.text: Hmph! No matter what job we do or what bounty we bring back, you always get a cut!
say:6:1122403005:1.source_cn: 哼，不管我们完成了什么委托，只要拿回酬金来，你就一定要...

say:7:1122403006:1.text: And that's not all! I see that chest with our hard-earned money over there! I bet you took all our money, didn't you?!
say:7:1122403006:1.source_cn: 这也就算了！但是放在箱子里的那些血汗钱，不也都是被你拿...

say:10:1122403007:1.text: Stop lying, you dirty goat-kisser! I've worked with Silverbeak for a long time, and never once did I see him take any of my money!
say:10:1122403007:1.source_cn: ——放屁！我和银喙结伴这么久，从没见他拿过我的钱！

say:11:1122403008:1.text: You're the only dumb lummox here! If he wanted to steal your money, did you think he'd do it in front of you?!
say:11:1122403008:1.source_cn: 蠢货！他要是想拿又怎么可能被你发现！

say:12:1122403009:1.text: When I came in just now, he was counting our money! If I hadn't stopped him, he would've run away with everything!
say:12:1122403009:1.source_cn: 刚才我来的时候，他就在数钱！要不是被我拦下，他早就卷钱...

choice_prompt:13:1122403009.text: When I came in just now, he was counting our money! If I hadn't stopped him, he would've run away with everything!
choice_prompt:13:1122403009.source_cn: 刚才我来的时候，他就在数钱！要不是被我拦下，他早就卷钱跑路了！

say:14:1122403010:1.text: Yeah, that's right! You and Silverbeak had a falling out years ago, and you're just now coming to collect some debt he owes. Who'd believe that?!
say:14:1122403010:1.source_cn: 说得没错！你和银喙好几年前就翻脸了，现在才来讨债，谁信啊！

say:15:1122403013:1.text: Yeah, it's been years. I didn't care, so I didn't pursue it.
say:15:1122403013:1.source_cn: 是，都过去这么多年了，我本来不想追究。

say:16:1122403014:1.text: But then he paid off Albert's debt, so it's high time to pay us what he owes!
say:16:1122403014:1.source_cn: 可银喙还了艾伯特的帐，也该还上欠我们的了！

say:19:1122403012:1.text: They had a falling out with Silverbeak years ago, and they're just now coming to collect some debt he owes?! You're lying through your teeth!
say:19:1122403012:1.source_cn: 他们和银喙好几年前就翻脸了，现在才来讨债，肯定是假的！
